# sonarqube_alm_bitbucket_cloud (Resource)

A Bitbucket Cloud DevOps platform setting. Every attribute changes in place. Destroying a setting that projects are still bound to is refused, because SonarQube would remove their bindings with it. Import ID: the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The *_wo arguments keep credentials out of state (Terraform 1.11+).
# Change credentials_wo_version to apply new values.
# Bitbucket Cloud requires the Enterprise edition or higher when a Bitbucket
# Server setting also exists.
resource "sonarqube_alm_bitbucket_cloud" "main" {
  key                    = "bitbucket-cloud"
  workspace              = "example-workspace"
  client_id              = var.bitbucket_client_id
  client_secret_wo       = var.bitbucket_client_secret
  credentials_wo_version = "1"
}

variable "bitbucket_client_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "bitbucket_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OAuth consumer key.
- `key` (String) Unique key of the setting. Changing it renames the setting in place, keeping its project bindings.
- `workspace` (String) Bitbucket Cloud workspace ID.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth consumer secret. Stored in state; prefer `client_secret_wo`. SonarQube does not return it, so drift cannot be detected.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only form of `client_secret`, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to apply a new value.
- `credentials_wo_version` (String) Any value; changing it applies the current values of the `_wo` arguments.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The setting key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_alm_bitbucket_cloud.example 'bitbucket-cloud'
```
